name: app-69e3522b53d48191933abd8950c16bc0
description: Search live flights and hotels from Akbar Travels in ChatGPT, compare options in interactive results, and complete your booking on akbartravels.com.

author.name: Akbar Travels of India Pvt. Ltd

interface.longDescription:
Search real-time flights and hotels from Akbar Travels without leaving ChatGPT.

Flights: one-way and round-trip, domestic and international, Economy to First class, up to 9 passengers. Compare fares in INR, check a 30-day fare calendar, and filter by stops, times, airlines and price.

Hotels: search by city or by hotel name, for up to 6 rooms with adults and children. Compare prices, star ratings, guest reviews and amenities such as free breakfast and free cancellation.

When you choose a flight or hotel, you continue to akbartravels.com to complete the booking. The app never asks for personal or payment details in ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Find flights from Mumbai to Delhi next Friday.
Show me hotels in Goa for 2 adults this weekend.
Find round-trip flights from Delhi to Dubai, leaving next Monday and returning next Friday.

positive.prompt: Find me flights from Mumbai to Delhi on 15 January 2027 for 1 adult.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_flights (from_iata=BOM, to_iata=DEL, onward_date=2027-01-15, fare_type=ON, sector_type=D, adult_count=1). Short chat confirmation, plus the flight widget in one-way view: a carousel of flight cards (airline, times, duration, stops, fare in ₹), each with a Book button that opens our booking page, plus a nearby-date fare calendar strip and filter/sort controls.

positive.prompt: Search flights from Bangalore to Goa, leaving 20 January 2027 and returning 24 January 2027, for 2 adults.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_flights (from_iata=BLR, to_iata=GOI, onward_date=2027-01-20, return_date=2027-01-24, fare_type=RT, sector_type=D, adult_count=2). Chat confirmation with onward + return counts, plus the widget in round-trip split view, two independent rows (onward and return), where selecting one card from each computes a combined total in the summary panel, which has a Book button that opens our booking page. Filters/sort apply to both rows.

positive.prompt: I want flights from Delhi to Dubai, departing 5 February 2027 and coming back 12 February 2027 for me.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_flights (from_iata=DEL, to_iata=DXB, onward_date=2027-02-05, return_date=2027-02-12, fare_type=RT, sector_type=I, adult_count=1). Chat confirmation, plus the widget in round-trip combined view: each card shows both legs together with one combined total fare and a Book button that opens our booking page.

positive.prompt: Find hotels in Goa for check-in 18 January 2027 and check-out 21 January 2027 for 2 adults.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_hotels (city=Goa, check_in=01/18/2027, check_out=01/21/2027, rooms=[{adults:2, children:0, childAges:[]}]). Chat confirmation ("Found N hotel(s) in Goa…"), plus the hotel widget, cards with photo, name, star rating, user rating, price per night in ₹, amenities, and a Book button that opens our booking page. Sorted by relevance, with amenity/chain/property-type filters and sort options.

positive.description: Search a specific hotel by name with multi-room occupancy
positive.prompt: Book the Taj Mahal Palace Mumbai for 2 rooms, one with 2 adults, and one with 2 adults and a 6-year-old child, from 10 February to 12 February 2027.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_hotels (city="Taj Mahal Palace Mumbai", check_in=02/10/2027, check_out=02/12/2027, rooms=[{adults:2, children:0, childAges:[]}, {adults:2, children:1, childAges:[6]}]). Chat confirmation, plus the hotel widget with the searched property pinned first and highlighted (red border), then other hotels. Each card shows photo, name, ratings, price in ₹, amenities, and a Book button that opens our booking page.

negative.description: Different transport mode (train/bus/car): The user wants ground transport (train/bus/car), not air travel. The model might mistake "Mumbai to Pune" for a flight search, but the app only covers flights and hotels, so it should not trigger.
negative.prompt: Book me a train from Mumbai to Pune for tomorrow morning.

negative.description: Managing an existing flight / flight status: The user is checking an existing flight's status, not searching new fares. The app only searches new flights and can't track status, so it should not trigger.
negative.prompt: Can you check my flight status for Bombay to Delhi, my IndiGo flight 6E 203?

negative.description: General hotel info, not an availability search: The user is asking about hotel policies/amenities in general, not searching live availability or rates for specific dates. There's no stay to look up, so the hotel search should not fire.
negative.prompt: What's the usual check-out time and cancellation policy at Taj hotels?

review.commerce_description: Our app helps users search and compare real-time flight and hotel options through Akbar Travels' inventory. For flights, it surfaces fares, schedules, one-way and round-trip options across domestic and international sectors and cabin classes, plus a nearby-date fare calendar. For hotels, it surfaces room rates, amenities, and ratings for a given city or property. No purchase or payment occurs inside ChatGPT, the app does not sell digital goods, subscriptions, or services within the chat. When a user is ready to book, they are redirected to Akbar Travels' own website (our own domain) to complete the booking and payment there. All prices are shown in INR.

publication.release_notes:
Adds hotel search.
- Search one-way and round-trip flights across domestic and international routes, compare fares, timings, stops, and durations, with a nearby-date fare calendar to find the cheapest days.
- Search hotels by city or by a specific property name; view photos, ratings, amenities, and live prices, with filters for amenities, chain, and property type.
- Rich filtering and sorting (price, duration, stops, airline, rating) so you can quickly narrow down the best options. Prices shown in INR.
- Search and compare only, bookings are completed on the Akbar Travels website, and the app can't track flight status or manage existing reservations.
